title: Patch: the changed-cards fuzz wave also plays each changed card on its Radiant face
thread:
**Issue #4161 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4161: Patch: the changed-cards fuzz wave also plays each changed card on its Radiant face
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a pull request changes a card, the fuzz gate already deals that card into both decks of about twenty extra games, so the changed rules actually get played before merge. But those games deal every card on its normal face: the card's upgraded Radiant face is only exercised if the game happens to upgrade it by chance, which is rare. So a change that only touches what a card does on its Radiant face can sail through its own safety net without the Radiant face ever being played. This change deals each changed card on its Radiant face too, in a small second batch of games, so both faces of a changed card are played before the pull request lands.

## Why

- The changed-cards wave (`play_changed_cards`) forces each touched card into both decks for `CHANGED_DEALS_PER_CARD` (20) games, yet nothing makes those copies Radiant: in-game upgrades are the only path, plus a lucky random mark on the small share of run-start seeds. A Radiant-only regression (wrong stats, wrong upgraded text behavior, a Radiant hook that panics) can pass its own targeted wave with zero Radiant resolutions.
- The gate already knows this blind spot exists: pool coverage prints a second, never-failing `coverage (Radiant faces)` line listing dealt cards no game resolved Radiant (`neverRadiant`). Today that line is purely informational, and on a card pull request nobody is told whether the *changed* cards were among the never-Radiant ones.
- The machinery to fix it exists: run-start games already carry per-index `deckMarks` that deal cards Radiant, and forced cards are placed first in each deck, so pinning the forced indices Radiant is a small composition of two tested paths rather than a new game mode.
- Not covered elsewhere: #4143 (forging Trade/Marketplace actions), #4151 (plain attacks held to the forecast) and the fused-pairs changed run all exercise other dimensions; none forces Radiant faces. #1363 (a Duos failure corpus) is unrelated.

## Proposal

- After the existing changed-cards wave in `play_changed_cards`, play a second, bounded rotation: for each changed card a deck can hold, play run-start games with that card forced into both decks and the forced indices pinned Radiant through `deckMarks` (forced cards sit first, so their indices are known after forcing).
- Name the new rotation in the summary (e.g. a `changed cards (Radiant faces): ...` line naming the cards and seed slice) and in `--json` alongside the existing `forced`/`coverage` fields; failures fail the gate exactly like the existing wave's, with the same `reproduce:` line plus the pinned marks so `--from N --seeds 1` replays them.
- Size it with two named constants beside the existing ones: a per-card Radiant deal count at or below `CHANGED_DEALS_PER_CARD` and a seed cap at or below `CHANGED_WAVE_MAX_SEEDS`, keeping the `rust (checks, fuzz 200)` job inside its time budget; skip it (with a printed line, as today) when no changed card is deckable.
- Rejected alternative: merely listing changed-but-never-Radiant cards in the summary without playing them. That makes the gap visible but leaves the Radiant face untested; forcing the face costs only a few extra seeds and actually runs the rules.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`: `play_changed_cards`, the `Forcing`/`force_into` path (forcing via `crates/tools/src/golden.rs`), `run_start_inputs`/`GameSetup::create_options` marks plumbing, new `CHANGED_RADIANT_*` constants next to `CHANGED_DEALS_PER_CARD`/`CHANGED_WAVE_MAX_SEEDS`, coverage `radiantResolved`/`neverRadiant` reporting; unit tests beside the existing `rotation_seeds`, `never_radiant` and `play_changed_cards` tests.
- SPEC sections: §10.7 (random-policy games and the fuzz gate), the #3113 changed-cards wave, #3283 run starts and deck marks, #2426 pool coverage.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A pull request touching a card with a distinct Radiant face plays that card Radiant-resolved: the Radiant rotation's `radiantResolved` includes it (or the summary names it resolved), verified by a test that would fail without the new rotation.
- [ ] Radiant-rotation games go through the same checks as the gate: invariants, replay fold back to the live hash, and checkpoint fold.
- [ ] A failing Radiant-rotation seed prints a `reproduce:` line (seed, forced cards, marks) that replays the identical game.
- [ ] No changed deckable cards means no extra games and a printed line saying so; `--from`, `--handicap`, `--cards` and `--json` runs behave exactly as before (no changed rotation).
- [ ] The added seeds stay within the new caps, and the `rust (checks, fuzz 200)` job stays inside its CI time budget.

## Size and risks

- Size: medium (one tool module plus its tests; roughly a day of focused work). No engine, card-script, spec-rule or client changes.
- Risks: a few extra seconds of CI on card pull requests (bounded by the new seed cap); run-start handicaps (drawn hero health, armor, extra cards/crystals) mean Radiant games are not plain-deal games, so the rotation complements rather than replaces the existing plain wave. No new flake surface: marks are pinned, not drawn, and all streams stay seed-derived so `--from` replays exactly.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Area: `tests` (`suggestions.areas`).

Class: `fuzz` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

## Goal

When a pull request changes a deckable card, `play_changed_cards` plays a second, bounded rotation after the existing changed-cards wave. In it every game is a run-start game: each changed card is forced into both decks and its forced indices are pinned Radiant through `deckMarks`. The rotation goes through the same checks as the gate, the summary and `--json` name it, and a failing seed prints a `reproduce:` line that replays the identical game. With no deckable changed card there are no extra games and a line says so. `--from`, `--handicap`, `--cards`, `--json` and `--regress` runs behave as before.

All steps are in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` unless stated.

1. **Constants.** Beside `CHANGED_WAVE_MAX_SEEDS` (about line 518) add `pub const CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD: u32 = 6;` and `pub const CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS: u32 = 30;`. Give each a doc comment: the Radiant rotation deals each changed card this many times, or plays this many seeds when that is fewer, which is about 7 seconds on the gate's runner. Both are ≤ the existing constants.

2. **`GameSetup`** (struct near line 1037). Add `radiant: usize`, documented as how many leading deck indices of a `Run` start are pinned Radiant (0 means none).
   - Add `radiant: 0` in the two full literals, `GameSetup::plain` and `GameSetup::handicapped`. Every other literal uses `..`, so nothing else needs the field.
   - Add the constructor `fn radiant(seed: u32, pinned: usize) -> GameSetup { GameSetup { start: StartKind::Run, radiant: pinned, ..GameSetup::plain(seed) }.with_drawn_endings() }`. It forces `Run` on every seed and keeps the seed's own endings draw.
   - In `create_options`, in the `StartKind::Run` arm, after `options.deck_marks = Some(marks)`, call a new free function `pin_radiant(options.deck_marks.as_mut(), self.radiant)` when `self.radiant > 0`. Do this after `run_start_inputs`, so none of its random draws move.

3. **`fn pin_radiant(marks: &mut PerPlayerOpt<Vec<DeckMark>>, count: usize)`**, next to `run_start_inputs`.
   - For each `player` in `PLAYER_IDS`, take `let list = marks.slot(player).get_or_insert_with(Vec::new);`.
   - For each `index` in `0..count`, find the mark in `list` with that index. If there is one, set `mark.radiant = true` and keep its drawn `upgrades`. Otherwise push `DeckMark { index, radiant: true, upgrades: 0 }`.

   - Add `radiant: false` to the three literals in `from_cards` and `from_changed`.
   - Add `pub(crate) fn pinned_radiant(&self) -> Forcing { Forcing { radiant: true, ..self.clone() } }`.
   - In `summary_line`, when `self.radiant`, end both formatted lines with `, pinned Radiant (each seed starts as a dungeon fight)` before the `\n`. Non-radiant text must stay byte-identical, because the existing test asserts `forced (--cards core-090): core-090 into both decks`.
   - In `Forcing::json`, build the object as today and add the key `"radiant": true` only when `self.radiant`, so the existing JSON is unchanged.

5. **`Failure`** (struct near line 2341). Add `radiant: usize`.
   - In `run_seed_with_options` set `radiant: setup.radiant` in the `Err(Failure { … })`.
   - In `Failure::start_options` add `radiant: self.radiant` to the `GameSetup { start: self.start, endings: self.endings, … }` literal. A failure's marks then include the pin in the report and in `--json`'s `marks`.
   - Add `radiant: 0` to the non-spread test literals of `Failure` (about lines 5173, 5861, 5877, 6121, 6170, 6518).

6. **Playing the seeds.** Beside `fuzz_handicap_seed` add:
   - `fn fuzz_radiant_seed(seed: u32, forcing: &Forcing) -> Result<Passed, Failure>`. It computes `pinned = forcing.for_seed(seed).len()` and `decks = GameSetup::radiant(seed, pinned).decks(pinned)`, then returns `forcing.play(seed, decks, |decks| fuzz_radiant_deal(seed, pinned, decks, reduce))`.
   - `fn fuzz_radiant_deal(seed, pinned: usize, decks, probe: Reducer) -> Result<Passed, Failure>`, which calls `run_seed(&GameSetup::radiant(seed, pinned), decks, probe)`. Tests pass a different `probe`, as they do for `fuzz_deal_probed`.
   - `fn play_radiant_wave(from: u32, ran: u32, forcing: &Forcing) -> Wave`, which calls `play_seeds(false, from, ran, forcing, |seed| fuzz_radiant_seed(seed, forcing))`.
   - Replay, hash, invariants, termination and checkpoint all rebuild the game from the same `GameSetup` through `create_options`, so no other check needs changing.

7. **Reproduce text.**
   - `reproduce_command(seed, handicapped, forcing)`: append ` --radiant` after the `--cards` part when `forcing.radiant`.
   - `report()`: in the `reproduce:` line add ` --radiant` when `first.radiant > 0`. Do the same in the closing `Reproduce one seed with:` line, using `failures.iter().any(|failure| failure.radiant > 0)`.
   - The report already prints `handicaps:`, `marks:` and `deckMarks` for a `Run` start, so the marks appear. Because the pin is derived from the seed and the forced list, the marks are the same on replay.

8. **CLI flag.** In `Args` add `#[arg(long, requires = "cards", conflicts_with_all = ["handicap", "duos", "regress"])] pub radiant: bool`. Doc comment: pin the `--cards` cards Radiant. Every seed then starts as a dungeon fight with them marked, which is how a failing Radiant-rotation seed is replayed.
   - In `run()`, after `Forcing::from_cards`, do `let forcing = if args.radiant { forcing.pinned_radiant() } else { forcing };`.
   - Choose the wave with `if args.handicap { play_handicap_wave } else if args.radiant { play_radiant_wave } else { play_wave }`.
   - `plays_changed` needs no change, because `radiant` requires `cards` and `cards` is non-empty.
   - Add `radiant: false` to the `args()` helper in the `fuzz_changed_cards` test module.

9. **`play_changed_cards`.** Keep the forcing and the existing wave as they are. After the `if forcing.cards.is_empty() { … } else { … }` block and before `fused_pairs::play_changed`, restructure like this:
   - The empty-forcing branch's existing line becomes `changed cards: none a deck can hold, so no wave or Radiant rotation`.
   - The non-empty branch ends with a call to a new helper, `play_radiant_rotation(&forcing, &mut failed)`, so both rotations run in one `else`.
   - The helper does the following.
     - It sets `let radiant = forcing.pinned_radiant();` and `let seeds = rotation_seeds(radiant.cards.len(), radiant.per_seed, CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD).min(CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS);`.
     - It prints `changed cards (Radiant faces): {n} pinned Radiant ({per_seed} a seed) over seeds 1..{seeds}: {shown_ids}`, copying the existing line's wording.
     - It runs `let wave = play_radiant_wave(1, seeds, &radiant);`, prints `wave.summary()`, and on failures prints `report(&wave.failures, seeds, wave.elapsed_ms)` and pushes `"the changed cards' Radiant rotation: {k} of {seeds} seeds failed"`. This is the same shape as the existing wave.

10. **Module docs.** In the `# Changed cards (#3113)` section add a paragraph on the Radiant rotation, covering `CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD`, `CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS`, the `--radiant` replay flag and the informational line. In the pool-coverage section, mention that the rotation's own summary puts `coverage (Radiant faces)` in play. Update `crates/tools/README.md` the same way: add `[--radiant]` to the `fuzz` row's synopsis, add a sentence to its changed-cards passage, and add a usage line `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 3 --seeds 1 --cards core-090 --radiant   # replay one Radiant-rotation seed`.

## Tests

All tests go in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, in `mod fuzz_changed_cards` or beside it, which already holds `ids`, `args` and `seatless`.

- `a_radiant_game_pins_its_forced_cards_radiant_in_both_decks`: for `forcing = Forcing::from_changed(&ids(&["core-090"])).pinned_radiant()`, build `GameSetup::radiant(1, 1)`. With its `decks(1)` dealt through `forcing.deal`, assert that `create_options(decks)` has `start == Run` and that both seats' marks contain `DeckMark { radiant: true, index: 0, .. }`. Also assert that `GameSetup::radiant(1, 0).create_options(..)` pins nothing beyond what `run_start_inputs` drew, by comparing it with the marks of a `StartKind::Run` plain setup.
- `a_radiant_rotation_resolves_the_changed_card_radiant`: `play_radiant_wave(1, CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD, &Forcing::from_changed(&ids(&["core-090"])).pinned_radiant())` has no failures (report text as the assert message) and `wave.coverage.radiant.contains("core-090")`, and `wave.coverage.deals["core-090"] == 6`. This test fails without the rotation. Then assert that the same card over the same seeds in `play_wave` does not resolve Radiant. **Probe this first**: if `core-090` never resolves Radiant, or does so by chance in the plain wave, pick another changed Unit with a distinct Radiant face and say so in the test comment. If the plain-wave contrast is not stable, drop only that contrast.
- `the_radiant_rotation_is_sized_within_its_caps`: assert `CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD <= CHANGED_DEALS_PER_CARD` and `CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS <= CHANGED_WAVE_MAX_SEEDS`. Assert that for 1, 10 and 633 cards `rotation_seeds(.., CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD).min(CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS) <= CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS`.
- `a_radiant_failure_prints_a_reproduce_line_that_replays_it`: as in `a_forced_failure_names_its_cards_and_its_reproduce_line_replays_it`, find a seed in `2..=SWEEP_SEEDS` where `fuzz_radiant_deal(seed, 1, decks, seatless)` fails under `Forcing::from_changed(["core-090"]).pinned_radiant()`.
  - Assert `failure.radiant == 1`.
  - Assert the report contains `reproduce: cargo jackioh fuzz --from {seed} --seeds 1 --cards core-090 --radiant`, and that `Reproduce one seed with:` ends in `--radiant`.
  - Assert the report's `marks:` line equals `json!(failure.start_options().deck_marks)` and that those marks hold index 0 radiant.
  - Replaying through `Forcing::from_cards(&failure.forced).unwrap().pinned_radiant()` fails again with equal `decks`, `message` and `forced`.
- `the_radiant_flag_replays_one_seed_and_stays_out_of_the_other_runs`: `plays_changed(&Args { radiant: true, cards: ids(&["core-090"]), ..args() })` is false. `reproduce_command(3, false, &forcing.pinned_radiant())` ends in `--cards core-090 --radiant`. `Forcing::json()` has no `radiant` key by default and `"radiant": true` after `pinned_radiant()`. `forcing.summary_line()` is unchanged without the flag and mentions `pinned Radiant` with it. Prove the clap constraints with `clap::Parser`: `--radiant` without `--cards` is rejected, and so is `--radiant --handicap --cards x`. If `Args` has no parser wrapper in the tests, use `<Args as clap::Args>::augment_args(clap::Command::new("t")).try_get_matches_from(...)`.
- Extend `a_change_with_no_card_plays_nothing_and_a_long_list_is_cut`, which already runs `play_changed_cards` on a missing root, so it still returns `[]`. The no-deckable-card line is covered by the first assertion in the next test.
- `the_empty_changed_forcing_plays_no_radiant_games`: `Forcing::from_changed(&ids(&["no-such-card"])).cards.is_empty()` and `rotation_seeds(0, 0, CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD) == 0`. This documents that the rotation is skipped with the printed line from step 9.

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools fuzz_changed_cards`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --lib fuzz::`, to check that the existing fuzz tests still pass; `Failure` and `GameSetup` literals changed.
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 20`, which must print no changed-cards output.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 5 --cards core-090 --radiant --json`, which must show `forced.radiant: true`, `starts.run: 5` and `coverage.radiantResolved`.

## Done when

- [ ] The Radiant rotation runs after the existing wave when a changed card is deckable, and prints the `changed cards (Radiant faces):` line and the resolved/never line.
- [ ] The rotation is capped by `CHANGED_RADIANT_DEALS_PER_CARD` (6) and `CHANGED_RADIANT_MAX_SEEDS` (30), both ≤ the existing constants.
- [ ] The rotation's failures fail the gate, and its report has a `reproduce:` line with `--radiant`, the marks and the forced cards that replays the same game.
- [ ] A test fails without the rotation and shows the changed card resolved Radiant.
- [ ] With no deckable changed card the rotation does not run, and `--from`, `--handicap`, `--cards` (without `--radiant`) and `--json` runs are byte-identical to before.
- [ ] README and module docs are updated.
- [ ] Checks pass: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, and the `jackioh-tools` tests above. `apps/web/src/wire` must show no diff.

## Risks

- **Determinism and replay.** Marks are overlaid after `run_start_inputs`, so no existing stream moves. `GameSetup` carries the pin, so `fold_args` and the checkpoint rebuild identical options. The new `radiant` field is 0 everywhere else, so non-Radiant games are unchanged.
- **Marked indices.** They are valid only because forced cards are placed first and `run_deck_size` keeps decks ≥ the forced count. `force_into` dedups, and `Forcing::from_changed` and `resolve_force` already dedupe the card list. `FORCED_SET_CARDS_PER_SEED` is 10 and equals `RUN_STARTER_SIZE`, so the minimum run deck fits.
- **Radiant is not guaranteed to resolve.** The random policy may never play a given card, so "never resolved Radiant" is only reported and never fails the gate. Making it fail would be flaky, so I rejected that.
- **CI time.** At most 30 extra seeds, about 7 seconds; run-start decks can be up to `RUN_DECK_MAX` cards, so check the printed seconds once.
- **Rejected alternative.** Forcing Radiant through a separate corpus or a new engine option, because the existing `deckMarks` path is enough and keeps the change in one tool module.

## Open questions

None. One judgement call: the replay flag is a new `fuzz --radiant`, which requires `--cards`. A `reproduce:` line can only replay a game from CLI arguments, and a Radiant-rotation game is a forced `Run` start that `--from N --cards …` cannot draw on its own.
```

## Risks

- **Determinism and replay.** Marks are overlaid after `run_start_inputs`, so no existing stream moves. `GameSetup` carries the pin, so `fold_args` and the checkpoint rebuild identical options. The new `radiant` field is 0 everywhere else, so non-Radiant games are unchanged.
- **Marked indices.** They are valid only because forced cards are placed first and `run_deck_size` keeps decks ≥ the forced count. `force_into` dedups, and `Forcing::from_changed` and `resolve_force` already dedupe the card list. `FORCED_SET_CARDS_PER_SEED` is 10 and equals `RUN_STARTER_SIZE`, so the minimum run deck fits.
- **Radiant is not guaranteed to resolve.** The random policy may never play a given card, so "never resolved Radiant" is only reported and never fails the gate. Making it fail would be flaky, so I rejected that.
- **CI time.** At most 30 extra seeds, about 7 seconds; run-start decks can be up to `RUN_DECK_MAX` cards, so check the printed seconds once.
- **Rejected alternative.** Forcing Radiant through a separate corpus or a new engine option, because the existing `deckMarks` path is enough and keeps the change in one tool module.

## Open questions

None. One judgement call: the replay flag is a new `fuzz --radiant`, which requires `--cards`. A `reproduce:` line can only replay a game from CLI arguments, and a Radiant-rotation game is a forced `Run` start that `--from N --cards …` cannot draw on its own.

## Goal

When a pull request changes a deckable card, `play_changed_cards` plays a second, bounded rotation after the existing changed-cards wave. In it every game is a run-start game: each changed card is forced into both decks and its forced indices are pinned Radiant through `deckMarks`. The rotation goes through the same checks as the gate, the summary and `--json` name it, and a failing seed prints a `reproduce:` line that replays the identical game. With no deckable changed card there are no extra games and a line says so. `--from`, `--handicap`, `--cards`, `--json` and `--regress` runs behave as before.

- [ ] With no deckable changed card the rotation does not run, and `--from`, `--handicap`, `--cards` (without `--radiant`) and `--json` runs are byte-identical to before.
- [ ] README and module docs are updated.
- [ ] Checks pass: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, and the `jackioh-tools` tests above. `apps/web/src/wire` must show no diff.

## Risks

- **Determinism and replay.** Marks are overlaid after `run_start_inputs`, so no existing stream moves. `GameSetup` carries the pin, so `fold_args` and the checkpoint rebuild identical options. The new `radiant` field is 0 everywhere else, so non-Radiant games are unchanged.
- **Marked indices.** They are valid only because forced cards are placed first and `run_deck_size` keeps decks ≥ the forced count. `force_into` dedups, and `Forcing::from_changed` and `resolve_force` already dedupe the card list. `FORCED_SET_CARDS_PER_SEED` is 10 and equals `RUN_STARTER_SIZE`, so the minimum run deck fits.
- **Radiant is not guaranteed to resolve.** The random policy may never play a given card, so "never resolved Radiant" is only reported and never fails the gate. Making it fail would be flaky, so I rejected that.
- **CI time.** At most 30 extra seeds, about 7 seconds; run-start decks can be up to `RUN_DECK_MAX` cards, so check the printed seconds once.
- **Rejected alternative.** Forcing Radiant through a separate corpus or a new engine option, because the existing `deckMarks` path is enough and keeps the change in one tool module.

## Open questions

None. One judgement call: the replay flag is a new `fuzz --radiant`, which requires `--cards`. A `reproduce:` line can only replay a game from CLI arguments, and a Radiant-rotation game is a forced `Run` start that `--from N --cards …` cannot draw on its own.
